title: UnitySMP Modpack
description: This is the offical UnitySMP Modpack!
body:
🌍 The Unity SMP Modpack

Minecraft 1.21+ | Fabric | Optimized for Multiplayer & PvP

Welcome to The Unity SMP Modpack — the official client-side pack for players on The Unity SMP, a survival multiplayer experience built for smooth performance, enhanced visuals, and an immersive community world.

This pack combines FPS-boosting optimizations, quality-of-life improvements, and PvP-friendly utilities — all tuned for compatibility and fairness across the SMP.

⚙️ Performance & Optimization

Enjoy a lag-free experience with top-tier performance mods:

Sodium, Lithium, FerriteCore, ModernFix, and ThreadTweak for maximum FPS

Indium, More Culling, Noisium, BadOptimizations, and ImmediatelyFast to reduce rendering strain

Very Many Players (VMP) & CCMME for smoother multiplayer performance

🎨 Visuals & Aesthetics

Experience beautiful graphics without sacrificing performance:

Iris Shaders + Complementary Shaders Reimagined for cinematic lighting

Natural Motion Blur and Enhanced Block Entities for realism

Variants-CIT for unique item visuals and Flowtives/Illuris textures for clean PvP looks

🧰 Utility & QoL Features

Stay organized and in control with convenient client tools:

Mod Menu & YetAnotherConfigLib for customization

Litematica & MaLiLib for building assistance

Shulker Box Tooltip, Armor HUD, Crosshair Addons, and Shield Statuses for better awareness

Mouse Tweaks, Zoomify, In-Game Account Switcher, and Chat Heads for smoother gameplay

🗡️ PvP & Survival Enhancements

Perfect for competitive and cooperative SMP play:

CPVP Essentials, Carpet PvP, and Mace Practice Pack for advanced PvP mechanics

Totem Counter & Custom Hitboxes for combat awareness

Gamma Utils (Fullbright) for visibility during fights

Freelook for better perspective in battle

🔊 Communication

Simple Voice Chat lets you coordinate, roleplay, or chat naturally in-game.

🧩 Compatibility

Built on Fabric 1.21+, this modpack ensures stable performance across a wide range of systems.
It includes all necessary dependencies such as Fabric API, Cloth Config, Kotlin, and others — so everything just works out of the box.

💬 About The Unity SMP

The Unity SMP is a community-driven survival server where teamwork, creativity, and fair play come first. Whether you’re building, exploring, or PvPing, this pack gives you the tools to play at your best.

IP and Discord info available in the server listing.

Play smoother. See clearer. Survive stronger.
Welcome to The Unity SMP. 🌍
